advancements.assortedeightbit.bobomb.des: Build a Bob-omb from a parabuzzy's shell
advancements.assortedmobs.root.descripti: Meet one of the creatures Assorted Mobs adds
advancements.assortedmobs.root.title: Assorted Mobs
manual.assortedmobs.chapter.eight_bit.bo: A Bob-omb you put down follows you, and when a monster hurts you it will walk up to it and light its fuse.
manual.assortedmobs.chapter.eight_bit.ca:
Be careful when hitting one yourself as its fuse will light.

One will ride on your head too. Sneak and use one you put down with an empty hand to pick it back up.
manual.assortedmobs.chapter.eight_bit.cr: A parabuzzy's shell under gunpowder and redstone makes a Bob-omb of your own.
manual.assortedmobs.chapter.eight_bit.pa: Parabuzzies hover more than they fall. A fish may tame one.
manual.assortedmobs.chapter.eight_bit.pe:
Use a parabuzzy you tamed and it climbs onto your head. There it can slowly heal, and you will drift down as gently as it does and take no fall damage.

Sneak on the ground to put it down.
manual.assortedmobs.description: The ice pixie, the treasure mob, the two 8-bit creatures, and the sea creatures.
